_comment: Copy to run.local.json (gitignored) and edit. Paths here are read by the vm_*.py tools on the Colab VM, which receive no argv when invoked through 'colab exec -f'.
_source_note: 'repo'+'commit' clone from a remote. To run a commit that is not on one -- without publishing it first -- build an archive with the remote-compute skill's package_git_source.py, upload it plus its .manifest.json, and set 'source_archive' to the VM path instead; vm_setup.py then verifies its sha256 before extracting and ignores repo/commit.
_data_source_note: 'url:<zip>' downloads the public dataset onto the VM. 'drive:/content/drive/MyDrive/<folder>' instead copies from a mounted Drive folder that already holds data/, weights/ and logs/ -- run 'colab drivemount' yourself first, it needs a TTY.
_persist_note: With a drive: source, symlink weights/ and logs/ into Drive so checkpoints survive the VM.
_persist_backend_note: vm_persist.py mirrors artifacts off the VM as they appear, so a reclaimed VM costs nothing. backend is 'webdav' (a Nextcloud/ownCloud share), 'wandb' (versioned artifacts), or 'both'. Remove this section to disable.
_persist_token_note: The share token is NOT in this file. Upload it as a file whose only content is the token, exactly like the wandb key. Prefer a file-drop (upload-only) share: a read/write share link also lets anyone holding it delete what you uploaded.
_experiment_note: Must differ from any released checkpoint name, or the final epoch overwrites it.
_eval_datapoints_note: null uses every trial, as the published run did. Small values (<32) can make a pooled-statistics column all-NaN and crash the evaluation.
_wandb_note: Upload the key as a file; never put it in this config, in argv, or in the repo.
